title: Acute forefoot and midfoot injuries.
journal: Clinics in podiatric medicine and surgery

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: Forefoot and midfoot injuries in the athlete are common. Injuries of the digits include subungual hematomas and fractures. Metatarsal fractures occur frequently in sports, and their treatments range greatly. Hyperflexion and extension injuries about the first metatarsophalangeal joint can be very debilitating. Midfoot sprains and fractures require a high index of suspicion for diagnosis.
